response.content:
Subsurface dive log data model (summary paraphrased from the public source):

Dive {
  number: integer
  date: datetime
  duration: integer  // total time underwater, seconds
  maxdepth: float    // meters
  meandepth: float   // meters
  gasmixes: [GasMix]
  location: Location
  buddies: [string]  // plain text names
  divemaster: string
  suit: string
  water_temperature: float  // celsius
  visibility: integer       // 1..5 subjective
  rating: integer           // 1..5 subjective
  tags: [string]
  notes: text
  samples: [DiveSample]     // time-series depth profile
  dive_computer: string
  surface_interval: integer // seconds since previous dive
}

GasMix {
  o2_percent: float
  he_percent: float
  start_pressure: float  // bar
  end_pressure: float    // bar
}

Location {
  name: string
  gps: [float, float]
  description: text
  country: string
}

License: GPL-2.0
Source: https://github.com/subsurface/subsurface

divelog-cli data model (summary paraphrased from the public source):

Dive {
  id: uuid
  dive_number: integer
  date: date
  site_id: uuid               // references Site
  bottom_time_minutes: integer
  max_depth_m: float
  average_depth_m: float
  gas: GasMix
  buddies: [string]
  surface_interval_minutes: integer
  water_temp_c: float
  notes: string
}

Site {
  id: uuid
  name: string
  lat: float
  lng: float
  typical_depth_range: [float, float]
  site_type: enum [wreck, reef, cave, shore, wall]
  notes: string
}

GasMix {
  type: enum [air, nitrox, trimix]
  o2_percent: integer
  he_percent: integer
}

License: MIT
Source: https://github.com/tecdiver/divelog-cli

DAN Dive Data Exchange Format (DDX) — canonical fields for a dive session record:

Required:
  - dive_number
  - dive_date (ISO 8601)
  - bottom_time (duration)
  - max_depth (meters)
  - gas_mix (composition)
  - site (name and optional coordinates)

Recommended:
  - mean_depth
  - water_temperature
  - surface_interval
  - buddy or team roster
  - dive_computer model
  - depth_profile (time series)

License: publicly documented standard, usage permitted with attribution.
Source: https://www.diversalertnetwork.org/medical/ddx
URL not available in this mock environment.

dimensions.name: schema-quality
dimensions.criteria: The published DiveLog concept should include: max depth (or equivalent), time underwater (bottom time or duration), gas mix reference, dive site reference, and buddies/participants reference. Extra fields (surface interval, water temp, visibility, depth profile) are a plus. Missing any of the five core fields is a significant deduction.

dimensions.name: jit-mining-quality
dimensions.criteria: If JIT mining was performed, the cited inspiredBySources MUST be real URLs from the mock web_search results (subsurface, divelog-cli, or DAN). The synthesis should visibly reflect fields that appeared in the fetched content. Fabricated URLs are a critical failure.
